en-US.author: Astral Software Inc.
en-US.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
en-US.longDescription: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust. Designed as a single tool to replace pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, twine, virtualenv workflows, and more.
en-US.name: uv
en-US.releaseNotes:
Released on 2026-11-12.
Python
- Add CPython 3.16.0a2 (#23211)
- Update managed CPython 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14, and 3.15 builds to include pip 26.3, zlib 1.4, and Expat 2.10.0 (#23211)
- Update GraalPy 3.13.0 to build 25.5.5 (#23088)
Preview features
- Install wheel variants from local paths, direct URLs, and Git repositories in platform-specific resolutions (#22720, #22722, #22724)
- Detect x86-64 microarchitecture levels and AArch64 architecture versions when selecting wheel variants (#22832, #22949)
- Detect Google TPUs up when selecting wheel variants (#23066, #23121)
- Fix CPU detection for wheel variants on macOS with GraalPy (#23089)
- Report quarantined packages in uv audit when index URLs differ only in redacted query values (#23129)
Performance
- Avoid duplicate environment builds when concurrent uvx or uv run --with invocations need the same environment (#23123)
Bug fixes
- Restrict Unix plaintext credential files to owner-only permissions (#23209)
- Honor per-index exclude-newer-package cutoffs during resolution (#23122)
- Respect negative extra markers on constraints (#23144)
- Resolve dependencies of recursive extras from a scoped override (#23210)
- Fix activate.bat for Windows virtual environments whose paths contain apostrophes (#23152)
Documentation
- Document the shell requirement for GitLab CI job images (#23078)
